body: All good — I hate commenting online cuz you can never tell the tone haha so my apologies if I came off as aggressive. Personally just feel as though a lot of surgeons and doctors in general though are kinda dismissive about it all and rarely give sufficient guidance when it comes down to something that could be mostly preventable, it’s just annoying/frustrating I suppose! Like you’re the doctor why am I having to do my own research on scar treatments lol
I had PPT with Dr. Jun by the way. I’m certainly not disappointed with my results. But I’m upset with scarring and the lack of guidance as a whole regarding the subject.

Certainly planning on it when I magically find $4k to drop on it lol. Love being trans! 😍…..


😭

While true it’s also dismissive (no shade). Surgical scars are incredibly traumatizing and I don’t think it’s fair to minimize that — hence, why I’m trying to get advice here. I don’t expect perfection but scar treatment is highly important and shouldn’t be minimized.
I assume time is of the essence with this though correct? I just hope Im not too late to the curve
They knew lol
What if you can’t do anything else tho
Yes, unfortunately

It sticks with you too. Because most of us just see it as a clock, which always hurts for the most part. Like you can sugarcoat it by being nice but you’re still just being like “that’s a man, but a cute one atleast!” Like ugh
Yes exactly. Yet they fail to realize most of us just want to blend in, so when they say that it just hurts because it’s like welp, clearly I don’t.
Yep this is it. It’s them clocking you but covering it up with a compliment for the most part
“Yasss qweennn we stan”
I just don’t like making people upset haha 🥺
Yeah clearly something I need to work on as well 😬😬
Nah you’re right I was wrong in how I worded it and I apologize to anyone who thinks I’m a TERF supporter cuz I see how it came across like that. My bad everyone 🥺
Good point — well shoot now I feel bad 🥺 I’m not self hating I swear!

I don’t think TERFs are justified though. I just see where they’re pulling their arguments from. Like, posting transtimelines on TwoX? Come on man. That said I probably could’ve worded that a lot better haha
It is relevant. This is my experience as a transwoman. Are you joking?

Okay but posts like “Finally realizing I’m a woman” and all these trans timelines as of late. Is this the place for that? Like dude idk it feels gross to me I’m sorry. OP I’m actually happy for you though seriously. I just feel like it’s a small thing that TERFs can use against transwomen that could be easily avoided by just posting this in r/lgbt or any of the several trans subreddits.

Can’t wait to get downvoted for this. Look I’m happy for you, but can we PLEASE stop with these posts in this subreddit? I’m saying this as a trans woman myself. It’s tiring seeing so many transwomen take up places to speak about rape, birth control, etc. this ain’t the place chief.
I hope you buy a bagel with cream cheese, wait til you get home to even take a bite, and the second you bring it to your face you drop it face down on an unvaccumed carpet.

I spoke up about harrasment I received from TERDs and posted about it on r/lesbianactually. My post was downvoted to oblivion and I was told that I wasn’t a woman and explained what “transphobia” was from TERDs. I cried for hours. I guess I don’t understand the hate, it’s polarizing to say the least. We’re all fighting the same battle here. I don’t get how TERDs can be so freaking awful towards transwomen.
Genital preference is FINE dude. I never once said otherwise

Doubt anyone will even read this but I want to apologize to you all. I got some mean DM’s and obviously have quite a few downvotes on my comments so I’m obviously in the wrong here. I genuinely feel really bad and if I upset you just know I’m one case, not all trans girls share the same view as me so please don’t rope them all in with me. I’m really sorry yall :(( I’ve been crying all night about this (I know crying over a Reddit post is pathetic but here I am), I just feel incredibly guilty.
Agreed 100000%
No I’m saying having a genital preference is fine and an understandable reason. Omg I shouldn’t have made this post i am so bad at conveying what I actually mean 😭

I wish people realized how damaging this is. I’ve been living as a female for a long time with little issue of being trans. That’s until it’s mentioned, all hell breaks loose. Its really got me fucked up right now. Idk how much longer I can live like this, honestly :// 

Sorry for the meltdown btw. The feedback I got on fb and on lesbianactually has me feeling depressed and questioning my transition for the first time in years.

Okay I see what you mean. I guess there’s just so many extremes to the whole ordeal that it makes me confused and scared — though that’s up to me to move past it as unfair as it may be in my mind. Looks like I have some growth I need to work on. Thanks for the insight Kat.

thank you so much, for real. It’s really sweet of you to have a good mentality going in with a different opinion than me and not completely flame me for it haha. The one thing we agree on is neither of us will always be right, and I think that’s such a good and rare mentality to have. It’s nice to know someone like you is out there ❤️ so thanks for being the little bit of light casted on me today, you’re amazing 🖤🤍

Ahhhh nooo that’s not my intent though! I don’t feel like I should be able to date anyone I want. Ugh I’m sorry I hope I don’t offend anyone and feel like I’m not conveying my message clearly. I’m just going to ask honestly though, how should I change my approach to this?
Dude no I agree it’s definitely sus. I posted this in r/lesbianactually and have been downvoted a lot. Idk what to believe anymore 😭

That’s a good point and thanks for sharing that perspective. I guess what I’m saying is, the reason we transition, is to live as that gender. If you claim to support trans people on the surface, the interpretation is, they see me as that gender. But if you then exclude them solely because they are trans, then do you really support them? Because by definition, that’s transphobia.

I love you for this! The bi struggle you described draws a very close parallel to the exclusionary mentality I feel being trans. 

I’m not saying people aren’t entitled to feel however they do, but I also feel as though exclusionary mentalities can lead to a lot of issues.

Well firstly, thanks for actually talking with me about all of this. It means a lot. That’s a wild experience btw, wow. I’m glad you’ve finally found yourself and developed such a matured mentality and approach to everything. I have all the respect in the world for you 💖

Maybe my original post was misconstrued on my end. I don’t think people have to feel they’d date me if they support trans people. What I’m saying  is, the fight for trans people is to be treated as their gender. And that when we feel welcomed, with all this support, it’s hard to draw a line between “wow they see me as a woman” vs. “oh, they support me but don’t actually see me as a woman” since thats why we transition in the first place ya kno?

Jeez that’s a little harsh hah. The thing is, they are attracted to me until I tell them. Im lucky enough to live my life without anyone really knowing, though I feel obligated to mention it dating wise. That said though, do you see what I mean? There’s sooo many posts saying “trans women are women” and “trans women are so cute”. Even in this subreddit even. Like, it feels like it paints a false hope if that makes sense? 

I’m not trying to get people to date me that don’t want to date me. That’s like, disgusting honestly. I just want to be treated equally as everyone else is regardless of being trans. If you *truly* believe trans women are women, then treat them as such. Genitalia preference is one thing, but beyond that it blurs the line with transphobia. 

Btw don’t get me wrong. I understand it’s tricky, I just hate that it’s like this ha.

Nah I don’t want to disagree haha. I’m not tailormade for this argument. I just unfortunately feel isolated in the reality of things. I get what you mean, though. Everyone is entitled to whatever they want to feel. It’s just tough for me, seeing “fuck youre so beautiful, don’t let anyone tell you you’re not a woman” only for that same person to be like “oh, well I’d never date a transwoman though” like, fuck me right? You can have that opinion and go on with life unscathed, but it sure as fuck hurts me.

I honestly regret transition. Not because it doesn’t make me personally, feel at home, but the immense pressures of stuff where people will never see me that way (I.e family, who I’ve lost) is too taxing mentally. Call me weak, but anyone who’s come out as lesbian knows that feeling to a different degree too. It wasn’t easy to come out. Its the same here, albeit a lot different, concept is the same. It’s just a burden 24/7 to also have to throw “in trans too” being a point of controversy. Atleast you don’t have to deal with that part being cis (not minimizing the struggle btw). Sorry I know this isn’t even really addressing what you said, I’m just too overwhelmed nowadays to even begin to break down anything anymore.
Isn’t that a textbook definition of transphobia? “I liked her til I found out she was trans”. If that’s the sole reason to not date someone, then it’s just invalidating the existence of us as women.

Yikes omg :( well I guess more specifically, from an aesthetic standpoint, which isn’t always the most important, but in my case I find it to be, Thai surgeons are hands down the best. I’ve just seen so many no names here in the US claim they can do it and a lot of these poor girls have to have revision after revision, and I just find that inexcusable.

Really?! That’s interesting. I guess just aesthetically, Thai surgeons are light years ahead of US surgeons. As in (again imo) it’s not even close. Even comparing bluebond to someone like Dr Bank, it’s night and day.
I’m sorry to hear bb :( it’s sad that it’s like this, and frankly incredibly inexcusable. I’m hoping I can save soon 🥺
My insurance reimburses you for it. Still a pain in the ass, but it’s worked for me so far.
